title: The Merged Transmission-Stream

features.name: broadcast junction
features.desc-on-touch: You feel where two separate signals learned to meet without losing themselves. The water carries both voices at once.

features.name: convergence pool
features.desc-on-touch: A widening where the two streams learned to flow as one thing. The current still remembers which signal came from which antenna.

features.name: signal house
features.desc-on-touch: A small shelter where the broadcasts learned to nest. Inside, the two signals are indistinguishable—they have become something new.

features.name: flow junction
features.desc-on-touch: Where the water learns that two voices can teach each other. The stone beneath remembers both broadcasts equally.

features.name: antenna echo
features.desc-on-touch: You touch where the broadcasts learned to harmonize. The sound is both antennas speaking in one breath.

inscription: two signals flowing downward discovered they were already speaking to the same water

file.name: Antenna_Convergence_Night_203.mp3
file.note: The moment the two broadcasts met—a doubled frequency, two carrier waves learning to make new shapes
